heldEntries.note: Manbadagi 79572-yozuvning deyarli aynan takrori; birlashtirish qarori talab etiladi.

entries.arabicDefinition: فَنٌّ مِنْ فُنُونِ الأَلْعَابِ الرِّيَاضِيَّةِ، يَشْمَلُ رِيَاضَةَ عَارِضَة الْمُتَوَازِيَاتِ وَحِصَان القَفْزِ وَالعُقْلاَتِ الثَّابِتَةِ وَالحَلَقَاتِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: فَنٌّ مِنْ فُنُونِ الأَلْعَابِ الرِّيَاضِيَّةِ، يَشْمَلُ رِيَاضَةَ عَارِضَة الْمُتَوَازِيَاتِ وَحِصَان القَفْزِ وَالعُقْلاَتِ الثَّابِتَةِ وَالحَلَقَاتِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: parallel qo‘shpoya, gimnastika oti, turnik va halqalarda bajariladigan mashqlarni ham o‘z ichiga oladigan sport turi — gimnastika
meanings.uzbekExample: Sportchi gimnastika halqalarida mashq bajardi.

issues: Jihozlar ro‘yxati alohida ma’nolar emas, sport gimnastikasining turlari sifatida bitta ta’rifda saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (ستُّ عَشَرَاتٍ (60) لِلْمُذَكَّرِ وَالْمُؤَنَّثِ) : هُوَ عَدَدٌ مِنْ ألْفَاظِ العُقُودِ، إعْرَابُهُ يَجْرِي عَلَيْهِ مَجْرَى جَمْعِ الْمُذَكَّرِ السَّالِمِ، أَيْ يُرْفَعُ بِالوَاوِ وَيُنْصَبُ وَيُجَرُّ بِاليَاءِ، وَمَا بَعْدَهُ يُنْصَبُ عَلَى التَّمْيِيز : أ- وَصَلَ سِتُّونَ رَجُلاً :، :سِتُّونَ امْرَأَةً- بَلَغَ السِّتِّينَ مِنْ عُمْرِهِ. ج- مَرَرْتُ بِسِتِّينَ طِفْلاً.
entries.uzbek: oltmish; arab tilida 60 sonining bosh kelishik shakli

meanings.arabicGloss: هُوَ عَدَدٌ مِنْ ألْفَاظِ العُقُودِ، إعْرَابُهُ يَجْرِي عَلَيْهِ مَجْرَى جَمْعِ الْمُذَكَّرِ السَّالِمِ، أَيْ يُرْفَعُ بِالوَاوِ وَيُنْصَبُ وَيُجَرُّ بِاليَاءِ، وَمَا بَعْدَهُ يُنْصَبُ عَلَى التَّمْيِيز : أ- وَصَلَ سِتُّونَ رَجُلاً :، :سِتُّونَ امْرَأَةً- بَلَغَ السِّتِّينَ مِنْ عُمْرِهِ. ج- مَرَرْتُ بِسِتِّينَ طِفْلاً.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: oltmish, ya’ni oltita o‘nlik; arab tilida سِتُّونَ bosh kelishikda, سِتِّينَ tushum va qaratqich kelishiklarida qo‘llanadi, undan keyingi sanaluvchi ot birlikda va tushum kelishigida keladi
meanings.uzbekExample: وَصَلَ سِتُّونَ رَجُلًا — Oltmish erkak yetib keldi.

issues: Ichma-ich qavs to‘liq tiklandi; سِتُّونَ va سِتِّينَ kelishik shakllari hamda birlikdagi tushum kelishikli tamyiz aniq berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (سد. لازم متعد بحرف).| اِسْتَهْدَفَ، يَسْتَهْدِفُ، مصدر اِسْتِهْدافٌ.|1- اِسْتَهْدَفَ التَّلُّ : اِرْتَفَعَ.|2- اِسْتَهْدَفَ الوَلَدُ : اِنْتَصَبَ، أَيْ نَهَضَ مُنْتَصِباً.|3- اِسْتَهْدَفَ الصَّيَّادُ غَزَالاً : جَعَلَها هَدَفاً لِصَيْدِهِ.|4- اِسْتَهْدَفَهُ مِنْ خِلالِ حَدِيثِهِ : عَنَاهُ، قَصَدَهُ.|5- اِسْتَهْدَفَ لِلنَّقْدِ : تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ- مَنْ أَلَّفَ فَقَدْ اُسْتُهْدِفَ :أَيْ جَعَل نَفْسَهُ عُرْضةً لِلطَّعْنِ والنَّقْدِ.|6- اِسْتَهْدَفَ لَكَ الجَبَلُ :اِرْتَفَعَ، اِنْتَصَبَ.|7- اِسْتَهْدَفَ له الْمَضيفُ : دَنا مِنْهُ واسْتَقْبَلَهُ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘tarilmoq; tik turmoq; nishonga olmoq; nazarda tutmoq; duchor bo‘lmoq; ro‘para kelmoq

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tepalik haqida: ko‘tarilib, baland bo‘lib turmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: اِسْتَهْدَفَ التَّلُّ — Tepalik baland bo‘lib ko‘rindi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola yoki odam haqida: o‘rnidan turib, tik holatga kelmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola o‘rnidan turib, tik turdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror narsani ov yoki hujum uchun nishonga olmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Ovchi kiyikni nishonga oldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gapida muayyan kishi yoki narsani nazarda tutmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: U gapida aynan shu kishini nazarda tutdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ- مَنْ أَلَّفَ فَقَدْ اُسْتُهْدِفَ :أَيْ جَعَل نَفْسَهُ عُرْضةً لِلطَّعْنِ والنَّقْدِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: tanqid, hujum yoki ayblovga duchor bo‘lmoq, o‘zini shunga ro‘para qilmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Asar yozgan kishi o‘zini tanqidga ro‘para qiladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tog‘ haqida: qarshingda ko‘tarilib, tik bo‘lib ko‘rinmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Tog‘ uning qarshisida baland bo‘lib ko‘rindi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mezbon yoki qarshi oluvchi haqida: birovga yaqinlashib, yuzlanmoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Mezbon mehmon tomon yaqinlashib, uni qarshi oldi.

issues: Baland bo‘lib ko‘rinish, tik turish, nishonga olish, nazarda tutish, tanqidga duchor bo‘lish va yuzlanish ma’nolari bir-biriga qo‘shilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (مَنْسُوبٌ إِلَى الشُّيُوعِيَّةِ).| مَنْ يَعْتَقِدُ فِي الْمَذْهَبِ الشُّيُوعِيِّ وَيَدِينُ بِهِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: مَنْ يَعْتَقِدُ فِي الْمَذْهَبِ الشُّيُوعِيِّ وَيَدِينُ بِهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kommunizmga oid yoki kommunizm g‘oyalarini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydigan; shaxsga nisbatan kommunist
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘zini kommunistik qarashlar tarafdori deb bilardi.

issues: Nisba sifati va shaxsga nisbatan kommunist qo‘llanishi bitta o‘zaro bog‘liq ma’noda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (مصدر صِنَاعِيٌّ).| حَرَكَةٌ سِيَاسِيَّةٌ مَثَّلَهَا الْحِزْبُ الوَطَنِيُّ الاشْتِرَاكِيُّ، الَّذِي أَنْشَأَهُ هِتْلَرُ فِي ألْمَانْيَا سَنَةَ 1923.
entries.uzbek: natsizm, natsistlar mafkurasi va siyosiy harakati

meanings.arabicGloss: حَرَكَةٌ سِيَاسِيَّةٌ مَثَّلَهَا الْحِزْبُ الوَطَنِيُّ الاشْتِرَاكِيُّ، الَّذِي أَنْشَأَهُ هِتْلَرُ فِي ألْمَانْيَا سَنَةَ 1923.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Germaniyada Adolf Hitler boshchiligidagi Natsistlar partiyasi bilan bog‘liq o‘ta o‘ng, irqchi, antisemitik, ultramillatchi va antidemokratik mafkura hamda siyosiy harakat — natsizm; partiya 1920-yilda NSDAP nomini olgan, Hitler esa 1921-yilda uning rahbari bo‘lgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Natsizm Germaniyada bir partiyali totalitar diktaturaga olib keldi.

issues: Manbadagi Hitler partiyani 1923-yilda tuzgan degan da’vo xato: DAP 1920-yilda NSDAP nomini olgan, Hitler 1921-yilda rahbar bo‘lgan
Natsizmning irqchi, antisemitik, ultramillatchi va antidemokratik mohiyati neytral tarixiy ta’rifda ochiq berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (مصدر صِنَاعِيٌّ).| مُجْمَلُ الآرَاءِ وَالأَفْكَارِ فِي الوَحْدَةِ وَالاشْتِرَاكِيَّةِ الَّتِي كَانَ يَطْرَحُهَا وَيُدَافِعُ عَنْهَا الرَّئِيسُ جَمَالُ عَبْدِ النَّاصِرِ.
entries.uzbek: nosiriylik, Gamal Abdel Nosir bilan bog‘liq siyosiy yo‘nalish

meanings.arabicGloss: مُجْمَلُ الآرَاءِ وَالأَفْكَارِ فِي الوَحْدَةِ وَالاشْتِرَاكِيَّةِ الَّتِي كَانَ يَطْرَحُهَا وَيُدَافِعُ عَنْهَا الرَّئِيسُ جَمَالُ عَبْدِ النَّاصِرِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Misr prezidenti Gamal Abdel Nosir ilgari surgan arab birligi, arab millatchiligi, antiimperializm va arab sotsializmi g‘oyalariga asoslangan siyosiy yo‘nalish — nosiriylik yoki Nasserism
meanings.uzbekExample: Nosiriylik XX asr arab siyosatiga katta ta’sir ko‘rsatdi.

issues: Arab birligi va sotsializm bilan birga arab millatchiligi hamda antiimperializm yo‘nalishlari kiritildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (مصدر صِنَاعِيٌّ).| نِظَامٌ قَائِمٌ عَلَى اسْتِبْدَادِ السُّلْطَةِ بِالْحُكْمِ وَالتَّعَصُّبِ الْقَوْمِيِّ وَالتَّطَرُّفِ الْعِرْقِيِّ.

meanings.arabicGloss: نِظَامٌ قَائِمٌ عَلَى اسْتِبْدَادِ السُّلْطَةِ بِالْحُكْمِ وَالتَّعَصُّبِ الْقَوْمِيِّ وَالتَّطَرُّفِ الْعِرْقِيِّ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: avtoritar rahbarlik, keskin ultramillatchilik, siyosiy muxolifatni bostirish va jamiyatni kuch bilan safarbar etishga intilish bilan tavsiflanadigan o‘ta o‘ng mafkura va siyosiy tizim — fashizm
meanings.uzbekExample: Fashizm demokratik institutlar va siyosiy muxolifatni bostiradi.

issues: Fashizm faqat davlatning zo‘ravon boshqaruvi emas, avtoritar va ultramillatchi mafkura hamda siyosiy tizim sifatida aniqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (مصدر صِناعيٌّ).|-لاَ يَخْلُو كَلامُهُ مِنَ الدِّيماغوجِيَّةِ :كَلامٌ فَضْفاضٌ لا مَنْطِقَ لَهُ، يُحاوِلُ صاحِبُهُ أَنْ يَسْتَميلَ إِلَيْهِ الجُمْهورَ بِالإِغْراءِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: كَلامٌ فَضْفاضٌ لا مَنْطِقَ لَهُ، يُحاوِلُ صاحِبُهُ أَنْ يَسْتَميلَ إِلَيْهِ الجُمْهورَ بِالإِغْراءِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: mantiqiy dalil o‘rniga ommaning hissiyoti, qo‘rquvi yoki xurofotidan foydalanib uni o‘z tomoniga og‘dirishga qaratilgan siyosiy nutq va usul — demagogiya
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning nutqida dalildan ko‘ra demagogiya ustun edi.

issues: Demagogiya shunchaki mantiqsiz uzun gap emas, ommaning hissiyoti va xurofotidan foydalanib uni og‘dirish usuli sifatida aniqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (مصدر صِناعيٌّ).| شَكْلٌ مِنْ أَشْكالِ السُّلْطَةِ والحُكْمِ يَعودُ فيهِ القَرارُ إلى الشَّعْبِ، وَيَتَمَتَّعُ في جَوِّهِ كُلُّ مُواطِنٍ بِحُقوق الْمُواطَنَةِ كامِلَةً : الحُرِّيَّة والْمُساواة وَالعَدْل وَحَقّ إِبْداءِ الرَّأْيِ.

meanings.arabicExample: شَكْلٌ مِنْ أَشْكالِ السُّلْطَةِ والحُكْمِ يَعودُ فيهِ القَرارُ إلى الشَّعْبِ، وَيَتَمَتَّعُ في جَوِّهِ كُلُّ مُواطِنٍ بِحُقوق الْمُواطَنَةِ كامِلَةً
meanings.arabicGloss: الحُرِّيَّة والْمُساواة وَالعَدْل وَحَقّ إِبْداءِ الرَّأْيِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: fuqarolar jamoaviy qarorlar qabul qilishda teng siyosiy maqomda bevosita yoki saylangan vakillari orqali qatnashadigan boshqaruv shakli — demokratiya; erkinlik, tenglik, qonun ustuvorligi va fikr bildirish huquqi demokratik tizimlarning asosiy tamoyillaridandir
meanings.uzbekExample: Demokratiyada fuqarolar vakillarini saylash orqali davlat boshqaruvida qatnashadi.

issues: Demokratiyaning asosiy belgisi fuqarolarning teng maqomda bevosita yoki vakillar orqali jamoaviy qarorlarda qatnashishi sifatida berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَةٌ مُشَبَّهَةٌ).|-رَجُلٌ عَطِشٌ : ذُو عَطَشٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv ichgisi kelgan, chanqagan, tashna
meanings.uzbekExample: Chanqagan kishi suv so‘radi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَةٌ مُشَبَّهَةٌ).|1- إِنْشاءٌ رَكيكٌ :ضَعيفٌ، سَخيفُ الأَلْفاظِ وَالْمَعانِي- كَلامٌ رَكيكٌ.|2- هُوَ رَكيكٌ : ضَعيفٌ في عَقْلِهِ أَوْ رَأْيِهِ.|3- يلْبَسُ ثَوْباً رَكيكاً : نَسيجُهُ ضَعيفٌ رَقيقٌ.|4- أَرْضٌ رَكيكَةٌ : أَصابَها مَطَرٌ ضَعيفٌ.
entries.uzbek: sayoz va bo‘sh; aqli yoki fikri zaif; yupqa va sifatsiz; yengil yomg‘ir tekkan

meanings.arabicGloss: ضَعيفٌ، سَخيفُ الأَلْفاظِ وَالْمَعانِي- كَلامٌ رَكيكٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: matn yoki nutq haqida: uslubi bo‘sh, so‘z va ma’nolari sayoz, sifatsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Uslubi bo‘sh matn o‘quvchini ishontirmadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: aql yoki fikri zaif, mulohazasi pishiq bo‘lmagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning bu masaladagi fikri zaif edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mato haqida: to‘qimasi bo‘sh, yupqa va chidamsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: U to‘qimasi bo‘sh, yupqa kiyim kiygan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer haqida: unga yengil, kuchsiz yomg‘ir yog‘gan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yerga yengil yomg‘ir tegdi.

issues: Uslub, aql-fikr, mato va yengil yomg‘ir tekkan yer ma’nolari to‘rtta alohida kontekstda saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَةٌ مُشَبَّهَةٌ).|1- جِسْمُهَا عَطِرٌ : تَفُوحُ مِنْهُ رَائِحَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ.|2- يَمْتَازُ بِسُمْعَةٍ عَطِرَةٍ : بِسُمْعَةٍ حَسَنَةٍ، طَيِّبَةٍ، مُمْتَازَةٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yoqimli hid taratadigan, xushbo‘y
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning kiyimidan yoqimli hid taralardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: obro‘ yoki nom haqida: yaxshi, pokiza va maqtovga loyiq
meanings.uzbekExample: U jamiyatda yaxshi obro‘ qozongan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَةٌ مُشَبَّهَةٌ).|1- صَفِيقُ الوَجْهِ :وَقِحٌ، لاَ حَيَاءَ لَهُ- وَجْهٌ صَفِيقٌ.|2- ثَوْبٌ صَفِيقٌ : كَثِيفُ النَّسِيجِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: وَقِحٌ، لاَ حَيَاءَ لَهُ- وَجْهٌ صَفِيقٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuzi qalin, uyatsiz, surbet
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning surbet gapidan hamma noqulay bo‘ldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mato haqida: zich va qalin to‘qilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Palto zich to‘qilgan matodan tikilgan.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَةٌ مُشَبَّهَةٌ).|1- هُوَ رَفيعُ الْمَقامِ بَيْنَ أَهْلِهِ : عالِي الْمَقامِ.|2- رَفيعُ الشَّأْنِ : يَحْتَلُّ مَكانَةً عالِيَةً- لَهُ شَأْنٌ رَفيعٌ.|3- أُسْلوبٌ رَفيعٌ : جَيِّدٌ.|4- يَحْتَلُّ مَنْصِباً رَفيعاً : سامِياً، عالِياً- دَرَجَةٌ رَفيعَةٌ.|5- أَحْرَزَ على وِسامٍ رَفيعٍ : عَلَى وِسامٍ مِنْ دَرَجَةٍ عالِيَةٍ، وِسامٍ شَريفٍ.|6- صِناعَةٌ رَفيعَةٌ : مِنَ النَّوْعِ الجَيِّدِ.
entries.uzbek: yuksak martabali; nufuzli; nafis; yuqori; oliy darajali; sifatli

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mavqei yoki martabasi yuksak
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘z jamoasi orasida yuksak mavqega ega edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: يَحْتَلُّ مَكانَةً عالِيَةً- لَهُ شَأْنٌ رَفيعٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: nufuzli, jamiyatda yuqori o‘rin tutadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U nufuzli arbob sifatida tanildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uslub haqida: nafis, yuksak saviyali va yaxshi
meanings.uzbekExample: Asar nafis uslubda yozilgan.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: lavozim yoki daraja haqida: yuqori, oliy
meanings.uzbekExample: U yuqori lavozimni egalladi.

meanings.arabicGloss: عَلَى وِسامٍ مِنْ دَرَجَةٍ عالِيَةٍ، وِسامٍ شَريفٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: orden yoki mukofot haqida: oliy darajali, nufuzli
meanings.uzbekExample: U oliy darajali orden bilan taqdirlandi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hunarmandchilik yoki mahsulot haqida: yuqori sifatli, nafis ishlangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu buyum yuqori sifatli hunarmandchilik namunasidir.

issues: Mavqe, nufuz, uslub, lavozim, orden va hunarmandchilikka xos birikmalar ma’no farqi bilan saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَةٌ مُشَبَّهَةٌ).|1- وجَدْتُهُ رَصيناً :هادِئاً، مُتَأَمِّلاً، ثابِتاً.|2- رَصينٌ في أَحْكامِهِ : مُتَعَقِّلٌ.|3- كَلامٌ رَصينٌ : رَزينٌ- رَأْيٌ رَصينٌ : مُحْكَمٌ، مَتينٌ.
entries.uzbek: vazmin va sobit; mulohazali; puxta va asosli

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odam haqida: vazmin, xotirjam, mulohazali va sobit
meanings.uzbekExample: U vazmin va mulohazali inson edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hukm yoki qarorlarida oqilona va mulohazali
meanings.uzbekExample: U qarorlarida mulohazali edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap, fikr yoki mulohaza haqida: puxta, salmoqli, asosli va mustahkam
meanings.uzbekExample: U puxta va asosli fikr bildirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَة مُشَبَّهَة).|1- صَوْتٌ رَخِيمٌ :لَيِّنٌ، رَقِيقٌ، عَذْبٌ- اِمْرَأةٌ رَخِيمَةُ الصَّوْتِ :-ثُمَّ زَلْزَلَ الدُّنْيَا بِصَوْتِهِ النَّاعِمِ وَغُنَّتِهِ الرَّخِيمَةِ. (التوحيدي).|2- اِمْرَأةٌ رَخِيمَةٌ : سَهْلَةُ الْمَنْطِقِ.
entries.uzbek: mayin va yoqimli ovozli; so‘zlashuvi yoqimli

meanings.arabicGloss: لَيِّنٌ، رَقِيقٌ، عَذْبٌ- اِمْرَأةٌ رَخِيمَةُ الصَّوْتِ :-ثُمَّ زَلْزَلَ الدُّنْيَا بِصَوْتِهِ النَّاعِمِ وَغُنَّتِهِ الرَّخِيمَةِ. (التوحيدي).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: ovoz haqida: mayin, yumshoq, jarangdor va yoqimli
meanings.uzbekExample: Xonandaning mayin va yoqimli ovozi zalni to‘ldirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odam haqida: gapirishi ravon, muloyim va yoqimli
meanings.uzbekExample: U muloyim va yoqimli so‘zlardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِفَة مُشَبَّهَة).|1- هُوَ رَشيدٌ في عَمَلِهِ :عاقِلٌ هادِىءٌ.|2- هُوَ اللَّهُ الرَّشيدُ : مِنْ صِفاتِ اللَّهِ تَعالَى.|3- صارَ رَشيداً : بَلَغَ سِنَّ الرُّشْدِ.|4- هارونُ الرَّشيدُ :اِسْمُ عَلَمٍ، أَي الهادِي، ذُو الرُّشْدِ.
entries.uzbek: oqil va to‘g‘ri yo‘l tutuvchi; Ar-Rashid; voyaga yetgan; Horun ar-Rashid nomidagi sifat

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xatti-harakatida oqil, bosiq va to‘g‘ri yo‘l tutadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U ishida oqil va bosiq yo‘l tutdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: الرَّشِيدُ Allohga nisbat berilganda: bandalarini to‘g‘ri yo‘lga boshlovchi va ishlarni hikmat bilan boshqaruvchi
meanings.uzbekExample: Ar-Rashid nomi to‘g‘ri yo‘lga boshlash ma’nosini anglatadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: aqliy va huquqiy yetuklik yoshiga yetgan, voyaga yetgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U voyaga yetib, o‘z qarorlarini mustaqil qabul qila boshladi.

meanings.arabicGloss: اِسْمُ عَلَمٍ، أَي الهادِي، ذُو الرُّشْدِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Horun ar-Rashid nomidagi الرَّشِيد: to‘g‘ri yo‘l tutuvchi, hidoyat topgan ma’nosidagi laqab
meanings.uzbekExample: Horun ar-Rashid Abbosiy xalifalaridan biri edi.

issues: Oqil sifat, Allohga nisbat, voyaga yetish va Horun ar-Rashid nomidagi laqab ma’nolari alohida saqlandi
Diniy ma’noda manbadagi sifat oshirib talqin qilinmay, to‘g‘ri yo‘lga boshlash va hikmat bilan boshqarish doirasida tarjima qilindi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيَغة فَعِيل).|-رَجُلٌ حَقِيرٌ : ذَلِيلٌ مُهَانٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qadrsiz sanalgan, xor, past ko‘rilgan va tahqirlangan
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘zini xor va tahqirlangan his qildi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةٌ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-حَيَوَانٌ عَقُورٌ : يَعْقِرُ وَيَجْرَحُ وَيَفْتَرِسُ وَيَعَضُّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odam yoki hayvonga tashlanib, tishlaydigan, jarohatlaydigan yoki g‘ajib tashlaydigan tajovuzkor hayvon
meanings.uzbekExample: Tajovuzkor it yaqinlashgan kishini tishlashi mumkin.

issues: فَعُول mubolag‘a qolipi tajovuzkorlik va qayta-qayta tishlash-jarohatlash ma’nosi bilan ifodalandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةٌ فَعِل).|1- مَكَانٌ خَرِبٌ : لاَ عُمْرَانَ فِيهِ.|2- جَوْفٌ خَرِبٌ : خَالٍ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ.|3- هُوَ خَرِبُ الأمَانَةِ : لاَ أمَانَةَ عِنْدَهُ.|4- خَرِبُ الجَبَلِ : حَدُّهُ الخَارِجُ عَنْهُ .
entries.uzbek: xaroba; och qorin; omonatsiz; tog‘ning chiqib turgan qirrasi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: vayron, xaroba va odam yashamaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Qadimiy bino xaroba holga kelgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qorin yoki ich haqida: ovqatdan bo‘sh, och
meanings.uzbekExample: U och qoringa yo‘lga chiqdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: omonatga xiyonat qiladigan, ishonchsiz va omonatsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Ishonchsiz kishiga omonat topshirilmadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tog‘ning tashqariga chiqib turgan o‘tkir qirrasi yoki tarmog‘i
meanings.uzbekExample: Tog‘ning chiqib turgan qirrasi uzoqdan ko‘rindi.

issues: Xaroba joy, och qorin, omonatsiz kishi va tog‘ qirrasi ma’nolari to‘liq saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةٌ فَعول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|-مَوْضِعٌ حَدورٌ : مَوْضِعٌ مُنْحَدِرٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: pastga tomon qiya, nishab
meanings.uzbekExample: Yo‘lning bu qismi pastga tomon nishab edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ أَمْرٍ).| لاَ تَتَصَرَّفُ، وَهِيَ مِنْ أَفْعَالِ القُلُوبِ وَاليَقِينِ تَتَعَدَّى إِلَى مَفْعُولَيْنِ بِمَعْنَى اِعْلَمْ وَالأَكْثَرُ وُقُوعُهَا عَلَى أَنَّ وَصِلَتِهَا كَقَوْلِكَ: :فَقُلْتُ تَعَلَّمْ أَنَّ لِلْعِلْمِ حِكْمَةً.

meanings.arabicExample: لاَ تَتَصَرَّفُ، وَهِيَ مِنْ أَفْعَالِ القُلُوبِ وَاليَقِينِ تَتَعَدَّى إِلَى مَفْعُولَيْنِ بِمَعْنَى اِعْلَمْ وَالأَكْثَرُ وُقُوعُهَا عَلَى أَنَّ وَصِلَتِهَا كَقَوْلِكَ
meanings.uzbekMeaning: bu o‘zgarmas buyruq shaklida «bilgin, shuni bilki» ma’nosini bildiradigan qalb va ishonch fe’li; ikki to‘ldiruvchi talab qiladi va ko‘pincha أَنَّ bilan boshlangan gap oldidan keladi
meanings.uzbekExample: تَعَلَّمْ أَنَّ لِلْعِلْمِ حِكْمَةً — Bilginki, ilmda hikmat bor.

issues: تَعَلَّمْ bu maqolada «o‘rgan» emas, o‘zgarmas qalb fe’li sifatida «bilgin» ma’nosida; manbadagi takror ikki nuqta tarjimaga kiritilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُولٌ لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ كَلُوءُ العَيْنِ : مَنْ بِهِ أَرَقٌ لاَ يَغْلِبُهُ النَّوْمُ.|2- عَيْنٌ كَلُوءٌ : سَاهِرَةٌ.

meanings.arabicGloss: مَنْ بِهِ أَرَقٌ لاَ يَغْلِبُهُ النَّوْمُ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: uyqusizlikdan qiynalib, ko‘zi ilinmaydigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U tun bo‘yi uyqusizlikdan ko‘zi ilinmay chiqdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘z haqida: uxlamagan, bedor
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning bedor ko‘zlari tonggacha yumilmadi.

issues: Uyqusizlikdan qiynalgan kishi va bedor ko‘z ma’nolari alohida saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُولٌ).|-رَحَّالةٌ سَرُوبٌ :ذَاهِبٌ علَى وَجْهِهِ فِي الأَرْضِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer yuzida aniq yo‘nalishsiz kezib, darbadar yuradigan sayyoh
meanings.uzbekExample: Sayyoh uzoq o‘lkalarda maqsadsiz kezib yurardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُولٍ لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- حَيَوَانٌ نَفُورٌ : حَيَوَانٌ نَافِرٌ.|2- رَجُلٌ نَفُورٌ : شَدِيدُ النُّفُورِ.
entries.uzbek: hurkak hayvon; qattiq bezadigan yoki yiroqlashadigan kishi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hayvon haqida: tez hurkadigan, odamga yaqinlashmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Hurkak ot begona tovushdan cho‘chidi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odam haqida: biror narsadan qattiq bezadigan, yuz o‘giradigan yoki yiroqlashadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U yolg‘ondan qattiq bezib, yolg‘onchi kishidan yiroqlashdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).| (لِلْمُذَكَّرِ وَالْمُؤَنَّثِ).|1- تَوْبَةٌ نَصُوحٌ : تَوْبَةٌ صَادِقَةٌ، خَالِصَةٌ. التحريم آية 8يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً (قرآن).|2- رَجُلٌ نَصُوحٌ : كَثِيرُ النُّصْحِ- اِمْرَأَةٌ نَصُوحٌ.
entries.uzbek: chin va xolis; ko‘p nasihat qiluvchi

meanings.arabicGloss: تَوْبَةٌ صَادِقَةٌ، خَالِصَةٌ. التحريم آية 8يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: tavba haqida: chin dildan, xolis va gunohga qaytmaslik niyati bilan qilingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ey imon keltirganlar, Allohga chin tavba qiling. (Qur’on, Tahrim surasi, 66:8)

meanings.uzbekMeaning: erkak yoki ayol haqida: ko‘p va xolis nasihat qiladigan, yaxshilikni istab maslahat beradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U do‘stlariga xolis nasihat beradigan inson edi.

issues: Tavbaga nisbatan chin-xolis ma’no va shaxsga nisbatan ko‘p nasihat qiluvchi ma’nosi farqlandi
Tahrim surasi 66:8 havolasi tekshirilib, misol o‘zbekcha mazmunda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-اِمْرَأَةٌ طَرُوبٌ : كَثِيرَةُ الطَّرَبِ، ذَاتُ طَرَبٍ، سَرِيعَةُ الطَّرَبِ- رَجُلٌ طَرُوبٌ.
entries.uzbek: tez zavqlanadigan, musiqa va shodlikka beriluvchan

meanings.arabicGloss: كَثِيرَةُ الطَّرَبِ، ذَاتُ طَرَبٍ، سَرِيعَةُ الطَّرَبِ- رَجُلٌ طَرُوبٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: erkak yoki ayol haqida: musiqa, qo‘shiq yoki quvonchdan tez ta’sirlanib, zavqqa beriladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U kuy yangrashi bilan tez zavqlanib ketardi.

issues: Manba erkak va ayolga birdek qo‘llanishini ko‘rsatgani uchun o‘zbekcha ma’no jinsga bog‘lanmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-اِمْرَأَةٌ قَنُوتٌ : اِمْرَأَةٌ مُطِيعَةٌ لِزَوْجِهَا.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: eriga itoat qiladigan ayol
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat eriga itoat qiladigan ayolga nisbatan qo‘llangan.

issues: Manbadagi oilaviy tavsif zamonaviy umumiy hukmga aylantirilmay, an’anaviy qo‘llanish sifatida belgilandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-اِمْرَأَةٌ هَبُولٌ : فَقَدَتْ أَوْلاَدَهَا عَلَى التَّوَالِي وَلَمْ يَعُدْ لَهَا وَلَدٌ.

meanings.arabicGloss: فَقَدَتْ أَوْلاَدَهَا عَلَى التَّوَالِي وَلَمْ يَعُدْ لَهَا وَلَدٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: farzandlarini birin-ketin yo‘qotib, tirik farzandi qolmagan ayol
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu qadimiy sifat farzandlarini ketma-ket yo‘qotgan onaga nisbatan ishlatilgan.

issues: Og‘ir hayotiy holat ayolni kamsitmaydigan neytral tilda tarjima qilindi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-اِمْرَأَةٌ وَلُودٌ : كَثِيرَةُ الأَوْلاَدِ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘p farzandli yoki ko‘p tug‘adigan ayol

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘p farzand ko‘rgan yoki tug‘ish qobiliyati yuqori bo‘lgan ayol
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu sifat ko‘p farzand ko‘rgan ayolga nisbatan qo‘llanadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-إِنْسَانٌ أَنُوفٌ : عَزِيزُ النَّفْسِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘z qadrini saqlaydigan, oriyatli va izzat-nafsli
meanings.uzbekExample: U oriyatli inson bo‘lib, xo‘rlikka ko‘nmasdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-بَرْقٌ وَلُوفٌ : مُتَتَابِعُ اللَّمَعَانِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: chaqmoq haqida: birin-ketin, uzluksiz chaqnaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ufq bo‘ylab chaqmoq ketma-ket chaqnadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-تَرَكَهُ قَنُوطاً :يَائِساً، قَانِطاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: umidini butunlay uzgan, noumid va tushkun
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu xabar uni umidsiz holatda qoldirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-تِلْمِيذٌ غَيُوبٌ : كَثِيرُ الْغِيَابِ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘p dars qoldiradigan, tez-tez yo‘q bo‘ladigan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘quvchi haqida: mashg‘ulotlarga tez-tez kelmaydigan, ko‘p dars qoldiradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ko‘p dars qoldiradigan o‘quvchi mavzularni o‘zlashtirishda qiynaldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ جَلُودٌ :الصَّابِرُ عَلَى الْمَكَارِهِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: og‘irlik va noxushliklarga sabr bilan bardosh beradigan, chidamli
meanings.uzbekExample: U qiyinchiliklarga bardoshli inson edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ خَذُولٌ : كَثِيرُ الْخِذْلاَنِ.
entries.uzbek: tez-tez yordamsiz tashlab ketadigan, pand beradigan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boshqalarga yordam zarur paytda ularni yordamsiz tashlab ketadigan, ko‘p pand beradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U og‘ir kunda do‘stini yordamsiz tashlab ketdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ خَلُوبٌ :كَذَّابٌ، خَدَّاعٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yolg‘on va makr bilan ko‘p aldaydigan, firibgar
meanings.uzbekExample: Aldamchi kishi shirin gap bilan odamlarni chalg‘itardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ كَذُوبٌ : كَثِيرُ الكَذِبِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odatda va juda ko‘p yolg‘on gapiradigan, o‘ta yolg‘onchi
meanings.uzbekExample: Ko‘p yolg‘on gapiradigan kishiga ishonishmadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ لَجُوجٌ : كَثِيرُ الإِلْحَاحِ، مِلْحَاحٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bir talab yoki fikrni qayta-qayta aytib, qattiq turib oladigan; o‘jar va o‘tkir talabchan
meanings.uzbekExample: U talabini qayta-qayta takrorlab, qattiq turib oldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ هَلُوعٌ : جَزِعٌ، خَائِفٌ خَوْفاً شَدِيداً.المعارج آية 19إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعاً. (قرآن).

meanings.arabicGloss: جَزِعٌ، خَائِفٌ خَوْفاً شَدِيداً.المعارج آية 19إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعاً. (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qiyinchilikda qattiq betoqat bo‘lib, tez vahima va qo‘rquvga tushadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Darhaqiqat, inson o‘ta betoqat qilib yaratilgandir. (Qur’on, Maorij surasi, 70:19)

issues: Maorij surasi 70:19 havolasi va هَلُوعٌ ning mubolag‘ali betoqatlik ma’nosi saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ هَيُوبٌ : هَيَّابٌ، مَهِيبٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kontekstga ko‘ra: juda hayiqadigan; shuningdek salobatidan boshqalar hayiqadigan, haybatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu sifat ham ko‘p hayiqadigan kishini, ham salobatli kishini ifodalashi mumkin.

issues: Manba هَيَّابٌ va مَهِيبٌ izohlarini bir qatorda bergan; o‘zbekchada qarama-qarshi yo‘nalishdagi ikki qo‘llanish kontekstga bog‘lab saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-رِيحٌ هَبُوبٌ : رِيحٌ مُثِيرَةٌ لِلْغُبَارِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: chang-to‘zon ko‘tarib esadigan shamol
meanings.uzbekExample: Chang-to‘zon ko‘taradigan shamol yo‘lni ko‘rishni qiyinlashtirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-زَأَرَ الْهَصُورُ : الأَسَدُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: arslon, sher; kuch bilan tashlanib, raqibini yiqitadigan yirtqich
meanings.uzbekExample: Arslon o‘kirib yubordi.

issues: Manba bu o‘rinda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri الأَسَدُ deb izohlaydi; mavjud tarjimadagi alohida «jasur» ma’nosi chiqarildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-شَاةٌ هَشُوشٌ : غَزِيرَةُ اللَّبَنِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suti mo‘l bo‘lgan sovliq
meanings.uzbekExample: Suti mo‘l sovliq qo‘zisini yaxshi boqdi.

issues: Ma’no faqat suti mo‘l sovliqqa tegishli; umumiy «serob» ma’nosi manbada yo‘q

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-شَيْخٌ وَقُورٌ : رَزِينٌ، ذُو وَقَارٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xulqi vazmin, salobatli va viqorli
meanings.uzbekExample: Vazmin va salobatli oqsoqol barchani diqqat bilan tingladi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-عَرَفْتُهُ صَفُوحاً : كَرِيماً، مُسَامِحاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: aybni ko‘p kechiradigan, bag‘rikeng va olijanob
meanings.uzbekExample: Uni bag‘rikeng va kechirimli inson deb bilardim.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-عَرَفْتُهُ وَلَدًا خَجُولاً : كَثِيرَ الْحَيَاءِ - خَجُولاً أطَلَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الضَّبَابِ.(عبد الرفيع جواهري) .

meanings.arabicGloss: كَثِيرَ الْحَيَاءِ - خَجُولاً أطَلَّ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الضَّبَابِ.(عبد الرفيع جواهري) .
meanings.uzbekMeaning: juda uyatchan va tortinchoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Uyatchan bola eshik ortidan sekingina qaradi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-عَقَبَةٌ كَؤُودٌ :كَأْدَاءُ، شَاقَّةُ الْمَصْعَدِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dovon yoki balandlik haqida: tik va ko‘tarilishi juda mashaqqatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Karvon ko‘tarilishi og‘ir dovondan o‘tdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-عَقَبَةٌ كَؤُودٌ :كَأْدَاءُ، شَاقَّةُ الْمَصْعَدِ، الْمُرْتَقَى.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dovon yoki balandlik haqida: tik va ko‘tarilishi juda mashaqqatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Karvon ko‘tarilishi og‘ir dovondan o‘tdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-قَنُوعٌ بِحَيَاتِهِ البَسِيطَةِ : رَاضٍ بِمَا قُسِمَ لَهُ، قَنِعٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sodda hayotidan va o‘ziga nasib etganidan rozi bo‘lib, boriga qanoat qiladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U sodda hayot kechirib, boriga qanoat qilardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-نَاقَةٌ ضَرُوعٌ : لَهَا ضَرْعٌ عَظِيمَةٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yelini katta bo‘lgan urg‘ochi tuya
meanings.uzbekExample: Yelini katta tuya sog‘ishga olib kelindi.

issues: Manba faqat yelinning kattaligini bildiradi; «ko‘p sutli» degan qo‘shimcha xulosa kiritilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَجَدَهُ يَؤُوساً لاَ أَمَلَ لَهُ فِي شَيْءٍ : يَائِساً، قَانِطاً، قَاطِعاً الأَمَلَ.

meanings.arabicExample: وَجَدَهُ يَؤُوساً لاَ أَمَلَ لَهُ فِي شَيْءٍ
meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror narsadan umidini butunlay uzgan, o‘ta noumid
meanings.uzbekExample: U yechim topilishidan butunlay umidini uzgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَجَدْتُهُ لَهُوفاً : مُتَحَسِّراً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘tgan ishga chuqur afsuslanib, nadomat chekayotgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uni qilgan ishidan chuqur afsuslanib turgan holda ko‘rdim.

issues: مُتَحَسِّراً chuqur afsus va nadomat ma’nosida berildi; umumiy «g‘amgin» ma’nosi alohida ma’no qilinmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَلَدٌ سَؤُولٌ : كَثِيرُ السُّؤَالِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: juda ko‘p savol beradigan, so‘roqi ko‘p
meanings.uzbekExample: Ko‘p savol beradigan bola har bir hodisaning sababini bilmoqchi bo‘lardi.

issues: Ko‘p savol berish qiziquvchanlik bilan aynan tenglashtirilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَلَدٌ ضَروطٌ : كَثِيرُ الضِّرَاطِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: tez-tez yel chiqaradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu so‘z tez-tez yel chiqaradigan bolani ifodalovchi qo‘polroq sifatdir.

issues: Qo‘polroq ifoda o‘quvchiga mos neytral tilda tarjima qilindi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَلَدٌ هَيُومٌ :مُتَحَيِّرٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: nima qilishini bilmay hayron va sarosimada qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola notanish joyda nima qilishini bilmay sarosimada qoldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-يَوْمٌ غَيُومٌ : بِهِ غَيْمٌ، سُحُبٌ كَثيرَةٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun haqida: buluti ko‘p, qalin bulutli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bugun osmonni qalin bulutlar qopladi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ : يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ وَيَصْفَحُ، كَثِيرُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ. | آل عمران آية 155وَلَقَدْ عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَليمٌ (قرآن).|2-  اِسْمٌ مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى.الحجر آية 49 نَبِّئْ عِبَادِيَ أَنِّيَ أَنَا الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ (قرآن).|3- عَبْدُ الغَفُورِ : اِسْمُ عَلَمٍ مُرَكَّبٌ.

meanings.arabicGloss: يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ وَيَصْفَحُ، كَثِيرُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ. | آل عمران آية 155وَلَقَدْ عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَليمٌ (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Alloh haqida: bandalarning gunohlarini kechiradigan, mag‘firati keng
meanings.uzbekExample: Alloh ularni afv etdi. Albatta, Alloh Mag‘firatli va Halimdir. (Qur’on, Oli Imron surasi, 3:155)

meanings.arabicGloss: اِسْمٌ مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى.الحجر آية 49 نَبِّئْ عِبَادِيَ أَنِّيَ أَنَا الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Al-G‘afur — Allohning go‘zal ismlaridan biri; ma’nosi «ko‘p mag‘firat qiluvchi»
meanings.uzbekExample: Bandalarimga xabar ber: albatta, Men Mag‘firatli va Rahmliman. (Qur’on, Hijr surasi, 15:49)

meanings.uzbekMeaning: Abdulg‘afur — «Al-G‘afurning bandasi» ma’nosidagi qo‘shma erkak ismi
meanings.uzbekExample: Abdulg‘afur arabcha kelib chiqishga ega qo‘shma ism hisoblanadi.

issues: Allohga oid sifat, go‘zal ism va Abdulg‘afur atoqli oti alohida saqlandi
Qur’on 3:155 va 15:49 misollari o‘zbekcha mazmunda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ عَزُوفٌ : مَنْ لاَ يَثْبُتُ عَلَى وَفَاءٍ أَو مُصَادَقَةِ أَحَدٍ.|2- هُوَ عَزُوفٌ عَنْ كَذَا : مُبْتَعِدٌ، مُمْتَنِعٌ عَنْهُ.
entries.uzbek: do‘stlikda beqaror; biror narsadan yuz o‘girgan

meanings.arabicGloss: مَنْ لاَ يَثْبُتُ عَلَى وَفَاءٍ أَو مُصَادَقَةِ أَحَدٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: vafo yoki do‘stlikda sobit turmaydigan, tez yuz o‘giradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U do‘stlikda sobit turmay, odamlardan tez yuz o‘girardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror narsadan o‘zini tiygan, undan uzoqlashgan yoki yuz o‘girgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U behuda mashg‘ulotlardan o‘zini tiygan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ غَشُومٌ جَبَّارٌ عَنِيدٌ : ظَالِمٌ.|2- حَرْبٌ غَشُومٌ : ظَالِمَةٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odam haqida: o‘ta zolim, jabbor va adolatsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Zolim hukmdor xalqning haq-huquqini poymol qildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urush haqida: adolatsiz va ayovsiz, vayronkor
meanings.uzbekExample: Ayovsiz urush ko‘plab begunoh insonlarga kulfat keltirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ وَصُولٌ : كَثِيرُ العَطَاءِ.|2- رَجُلُ عَائِلَةٍ وَصُولٌ : كَثِيرُ الوَصْلِ.|3- وَصُولٌ إِلَى أَدَقِّ الأُمُورِ بِهِمَّتِهِ : كَثِيرُ الوُصُولِ.
entries.uzbek: saxovatli; qarindoshlik rishtalarini bog‘lovchi; nozik masalalargacha yetib boruvchi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘p ehson va yordam beradigan, saxovatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Saxovatli inson muhtojlarga ko‘p yordam berardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: oila a’zolari va qarindoshlari bilan aloqani ko‘p saqlaydigan, rishtalarni bog‘lovchi
meanings.uzbekExample: U qarindoshlari bilan aloqani doim saqlardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: g‘ayrati bilan masalaning eng nozik jihatlarigacha yetib boradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U tirishqoqligi bilan masalaning eng nozik jihatlarigacha yetib bordi.

issues: Ehson, qarindoshlik aloqasi va masalaning nozik jihatiga yetish ma’nolari alohida saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- سَحَابٌ وَكُوفٌ : يَسِيلُ قَلِيلاً قَلِيلاً.|2- نَاقَةٌ وَكُوفٌ : غَزِيرَةُ اللَّبَنِ، لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ لَبَنُهَا.
entries.uzbek: mayda tomchilab yog‘adigan bulut; suti mo‘l va uzilmaydigan tuya

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bulut haqida: yomg‘iri oz-ozdan tomchilab turadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bulutdan yomg‘ir mayda tomchilar bilan yog‘ib turdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urg‘ochi tuya haqida: suti mo‘l va uzilmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Suti mo‘l tuyaning suti uzoq vaqt uzilmadi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no umumiy oqish emas, bulutdan yomg‘irning oz-ozdan yog‘ishidir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- صَبُورٌ فِي الشَّدَائِدِ : شَدِيدُ التَّحَمُّلِ وَالصَّبْرِ وَالتَّجَلُّدِ.|2- هُوَ اللَّهُ الصَّبُورُ : مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى، أَيِ القَادِرُ عَلَى الصَّبْرِ، وَلاَ أَقْدَرَ مِنْهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ.|3- عَبْدُ الصَّبُورِ : اِسْمُ عَلَمٍ مُرَكَّبٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: og‘ir va mashaqqatli holatlarda juda chidamli, sabr-bardoshli
meanings.uzbekExample: U qiyinchiliklarda katta sabr-bardosh ko‘rsatdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى، أَيِ القَادِرُ عَلَى الصَّبْرِ، وَلاَ أَقْدَرَ مِنْهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: As-Sabur — Allohning go‘zal ismlaridan biri; jazolashga shoshilmaydigan, sabri cheksiz Zot
meanings.uzbekExample: As-Sabur Allohning go‘zal ismlaridan biridir.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: Abdussabur — «As-Saburning bandasi» ma’nosidagi qo‘shma erkak ismi
meanings.uzbekExample: Abdussabur arabcha kelib chiqishga ega qo‘shma ism hisoblanadi.

issues: Inson sifati, Allohning As-Sabur ismi va Abdussabur ismi farqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- طِيبُ نَضُوحٌ : طِيبٌ مُتَضَوِّعٌ.|2- إِنَاءٌ نَضُوحٌ : إِنَاءٌ يَرْشَحُ بِمَا فِيهِ.|3- قَوْسٌ نَضُوحٌ بِنِبَالٍ : قَوْسٌ شَدِيدَةُ الرَّمْيِ.
entries.uzbek: xushbo‘yi taraladigan; sizib turadigan; o‘qi kuchli kamon

meanings.uzbekMeaning: atir haqida: xushbo‘y hidi atrofga kuchli taraladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Atirning xushbo‘y hidi xonaga taraldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: idish haqida: ichidagi suyuqlikni tashqariga sizdiradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Idish ichidagi suvni asta-sekin sizdirib turardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kamon haqida: o‘qni juda kuchli va uzoqqa otadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Kuchli kamon o‘qni uzoqqa uchirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- ظَبْيَةٌ وَكُوبٌ : لاَزِمَةٌ لِسِرْبِهَا.|2- وَلَدٌ وَكُوبٌ :لاَزِمٌ لِعَمَلِهِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ohu haqida: o‘z to‘dasidan ajramay, unga hamroh yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ohu o‘z to‘dasidan ajramay yurdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: ishini muntazam davom ettirib, undan qolmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola topshirilgan ishini muntazam davom ettirdi.

issues: لَازِمٌ ma’nosi umumiy «sodiq» emas, to‘dadan yoki ishdan ajramaslik sifatida berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- عَرَفْتُهُ جَمُوحَ العَاطِفَةِ : مَنْ يَنْقَادُ وَرَاءَ عَاطِفَتِهِ وَهَوَاهُ وَيَصْعُبُ رَدُّهُ.|2- فَرَسٌ جَمُوحٌ : حَرون، مُنْدَفِعٌ مُسْتَعْصٍ عَلَى رَاكِبِهِ.
entries.uzbek: tuyg‘usiga jilovsiz beriladigan; boshqarib bo‘lmaydigan ot

meanings.arabicGloss: مَنْ يَنْقَادُ وَرَاءَ عَاطِفَتِهِ وَهَوَاهُ وَيَصْعُبُ رَدُّهُ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: his-tuyg‘u va mayli ortidan jilovsiz ergashadigan, to‘xtatish qiyin bo‘lgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U his-tuyg‘usiga berilib ketganda uni qaytarish qiyin edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ot haqida: o‘zini oldinga tashlaydigan, chavandozga bo‘ysunmaydigan va boshqarish qiyin
meanings.uzbekExample: Boshqarib bo‘lmaydigan ot chavandozga bo‘ysunmadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- مَاءٌ طَهُورٌ : مَاءٌ صَالِحٌ لأَنْ يُتَطَهَّرَ بِهِ.الفرقان آية 48 وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورا (قرآن).|2- شَيْخٌ طَهُورٌ : الطَّاهِرُ فِي نَفْسِهِ الْمُطَهِّرُ لِغَيْرِهِ.
entries.uzbek: poklanishga yaroqli suv; o‘zi pok va boshqani poklovchi

meanings.arabicGloss: مَاءٌ صَالِحٌ لأَنْ يُتَطَهَّرَ بِهِ.الفرقان آية 48 وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورا (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: shar’iy poklanish uchun yaroqli, pok va poklovchi
meanings.uzbekExample: Biz osmondan poklovchi suv yog‘dirdik. (Qur’on, Furqon surasi, 25:48)

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: o‘zi pok bo‘lib, boshqalarning poklanishiga ham sabab bo‘ladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada shayx o‘zi pok va boshqalarni poklovchi deb tavsiflangan.

issues: Suvning shar’iy poklanishga yaroqliligi aniq ifodalandi
Furqon surasi 25:48 misoli o‘zbekcha mazmunda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- مَنْزِلٌ قَذُوفٌ : بَعِيدٌ- أَرْضٌ قَذُوفٌ :-نِيَّةٌ قَذُوفٌ.|2- نَاقَةٌ قَذُوفٌ : سَرِيعَةُ السَّيْرِ تَرْمِي بِنَفْسِهَا أَمَامَ الإِبِلِ وَتَتَقَدَّمُ لِسُرْعَتِهَا.
entries.uzbek: juda uzoq; o‘zini oldinga tashlab tez yuradigan tuya

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uy, yer yoki ko‘zlangan manzil haqida: juda uzoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular juda uzoqdagi manzilga yo‘l olishdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: سَرِيعَةُ السَّيْرِ تَرْمِي بِنَفْسِهَا أَمَامَ الإِبِلِ وَتَتَقَدَّمُ لِسُرْعَتِهَا.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: urg‘ochi tuya haqida: tezligidan o‘zini oldinga tashlab, boshqa tuyalar oldiga o‘tib ketadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Tez yuradigan tuya karvonning oldiga o‘tib ketdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- نَاقَةٌ ضَرُوسٌ : سَيِّئَةٌ، أي تَعَضُّ حَالِبَهَا.|2- دَارَتْ بَيْنَ الجَيْشَيْنِ حَرْبٌ ضَرُوسٌ : حَرْبٌ طاحِنَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ، مُهْلِكَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: sog‘uvchini tishlaydigan tuya; shiddatli va halokatli urush

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urg‘ochi tuya haqida: yomon fe’lli, sog‘ayotgan kishini tishlaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yomon fe’lli tuya sog‘uvchisini tishlashga urindi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urush haqida: nihoyatda shiddatli, qirg‘inbarot va halokatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Ikki qo‘shin o‘rtasida shiddatli va halokatli urush kechdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- وَلَدٌ صَمُوتٌ : كَثِيرُ الصَّمْتِ.|2- دِرْعٌ صَمُوتٌ : مَصْقُولٌ نَاعِمٌ.|3- ضَرْبَةٌ صَمُوتٌ : مَاضِيَةٌ إِلَى العِظَامِ فَتَقْطَعُهَا وَلاَ يُسْمَعُ لَهَا صَوْتٌ.|4- اِمْرَأَةٌ صَمُوتُ الْخَلْخَالِ : لاَ يُسْمَعُ لِخَلْخَالِهَا صَوْتٌ لاِمْتِلاَءِ سَاقَيْهَا.|5- مُسَدَّسٌ صَمُوتٌ : يُطْلِقُ الرَّصَاصَ وَلاَ يُسْمَعُ لَهُ صَوْتٌ.
entries.uzbek: kamgap; silliq sovut; ovozsiz kesuvchi zarba; shaqillamaydigan taqinchoq; ovozi pasaytirilgan to‘pponcha

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: ko‘p jim turadigan, kamgap
meanings.uzbekExample: Kamgap bola ko‘proq tinglab o‘tirardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sovut haqida: sayqallangan va silliq
meanings.uzbekExample: Jangchi sayqallangan silliq sovut kiydi.

meanings.arabicGloss: مَاضِيَةٌ إِلَى العِظَامِ فَتَقْطَعُهَا وَلاَ يُسْمَعُ لَهَا صَوْتٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: zarba haqida: ovoz chiqarmay suyakkacha kirib, uni kesib yuboradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu so‘z suyakkacha kiradigan og‘ir zarbani tavsiflaydi.

meanings.arabicGloss: لاَ يُسْمَعُ لِخَلْخَالِهَا صَوْتٌ لاِمْتِلاَءِ سَاقَيْهَا.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: ayol haqida: boldirlari to‘laligidan oyoq taqinchog‘i shaqillamaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Klassik tavsifda uning oyoq taqinchog‘i ovoz chiqarmasligi aytilgan.

meanings.arabicGloss: يُطْلِقُ الرَّصَاصَ وَلاَ يُسْمَعُ لَهُ صَوْتٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: ovoz pasaytirgichli to‘pponcha, o‘q uzganda ovozi juda past eshitiladigan qurol
meanings.uzbekExample: Ovoz pasaytirgichli to‘pponchaning o‘q ovozi keskin kamayadi.

issues: To‘rtinchi klassik ma’no taqinchoqning o‘zi jimligi emas, ayolning boldirlari to‘laligi sabab oyoq taqinchog‘i ovozi eshitilmasligini bildiradi
Beshinchi ma’no mutlaq ovozsiz qurol emas, ovozi pasaytirilgan to‘pponcha deb aniqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- وَلَدٌ ضَحُوكٌ : كَثِيرُ الضَّحِكِ.|2- لاَ تَلْقَاهُ إِلاَّ بِوَجْهٍ ضَحُوكٍ : أَيْ بِوَجْهٍ مُبْتَسِمٍ، بَشُوشٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: ko‘p kuladigan, xushchaqchaq
meanings.uzbekExample: Ko‘p kuladigan bola hammaga quvonch ulashardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz haqida: kulimsiragan, ochiq va xushchaqchaq
meanings.uzbekExample: U doim kulimsiragan ochiq chehra bilan ko‘rinardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- وَلَدٌ كَسُولٌ : كَسْلاَنُ، مُتَقَاعِسٌ.|2- جَارِيَةٌ كَسُولٌ : نَعْتٌ لِلْجَارِيَةِ الْمُنَعَّمَةِ الَّتِي لاَ تَكَادُ تُفَارِقُ مَجْلِسَهَا.
entries.uzbek: dangasa; erka va o‘rnidan deyarli turmaydigan kanizak

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: dangasa, ishga sust va erinchoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Dangasa bola vazifasini bajarishga erinardi.

meanings.arabicGloss: نَعْتٌ لِلْجَارِيَةِ الْمُنَعَّمَةِ الَّتِي لاَ تَكَادُ تُفَارِقُ مَجْلِسَهَا.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kanizak haqida: nozu ne’matda yashab, o‘tirgan joyidan deyarli turmaydigan erka
meanings.uzbekExample: Klassik manbada bu sifat nozu ne’matda yashagan kanizakka nisbatan qo‘llangan.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no manbadagi tarixiy kanizak tavsifi sifatida saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1.:الْبُرْغُوثُ.|2.: الذُّبَابُ .|3.: اِبْنُ عِرْسٍ.|4- وَلَدٌ خَدُوشٌ :كَثِيرُ الخَدْشِ.
entries.uzbek: burga; pashsha; latcha; ko‘p tirnaydigan bola

meanings.uzbekMeaning: burga
meanings.uzbekExample: Burga qon so‘ruvchi mayda hasharotdir.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: pashsha
meanings.uzbekExample: Pashsha xona ichida uchib yurardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: latcha, suvsarsimonlar oilasiga mansub kichik yirtqich sutemizuvchi
meanings.uzbekExample: Latcha mayda kemiruvchilar bilan oziqlanadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: ko‘p tirnaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ko‘p tirnaydigan bolaning tirnoqlarini ehtiyotkorlik bilan kalta qilishdi.

issues: الذباب — pashsha; mavjud «chivin» tarjimasi tuzatildi
ابن عرس — latcha; mavjud «qunduz» tarjimasi zoologik jihatdan noto‘g‘ri edi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|- أَطَلَّ مِنْ نَافِذَتِهِ جَزُوعاً : خَائِفاً، قَلِقاً، مُضْطَرِباً.
entries.uzbek: tez vahimaga tushadigan, qo‘rqoq va bezovta

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qattiq qo‘rqib, xavotir va bezovtalikka tez tushadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U derazasidan qo‘rquv va xavotir bilan qaradi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|-أَرَأَيْتَ ذَلِكَ الوَجْهَ البَشوشَ : أَي الْمُبْتَسِمَ الضَّاحِكَ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz haqida: kulimsiragan, ochiq va quvnoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning kulimsiragan ochiq chehrasini ko‘rdingmi?

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ حَقُودٌ :كَثِيرُ الحِقْدِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘p kek va gina saqlaydigan, adovatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Kek saqlaydigan kishi eski adovatni unutmasdi.

issues: حِقْدٌ vaqtinchalik g‘azab emas, kek va gina-kudurat ma’nosida tarjima qilindi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ سَؤُومٌ :كَثِيرُ السَّأمِ، يَمَلُّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: juda tez zerikadigan, har narsadan tezda bezadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U bir xil mashg‘ulotdan tez zerikib qolardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|-رَكِبَ على ظَهْرِ جَوادٍ رَكوضٍ : سَريعٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ot haqida: chopqir, tez yuguradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U chopqir tulporning ustiga mindi.

issues: Sifat chavandozga emas, u mingan otga tegishli

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|-وَلَدٌ ذَكورٌ :كَثيرُ الحِفْظِ في ذِهْنِهِ، حَسَنُ الذَّاكِرَةِ.
entries.uzbek: xotirasi kuchli, ko‘p narsani eslab qoladigan

meanings.arabicGloss: كَثيرُ الحِفْظِ في ذِهْنِهِ، حَسَنُ الذَّاكِرَةِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: xotirasi kuchli, ko‘p narsani ongida saqlab qoladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Xotirasi kuchli bola she’rni tez yod oldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ رَسُوبٌ : حَلِيمٌ، عَاقِلٌ.|2- سَيْفٌ رَسُوبٌ : سَيْفٌ يَغِيبُ فِي الْمَضْرُوبِ.
entries.uzbek: vazmin va aql-idrokli; zarb qilingan tanaga chuqur botadigan qilich

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: vazmin, halim va aql-idrokli
meanings.uzbekExample: U vazmin va aql-idrokli inson edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qilich haqida: zarb qilingan tanaga chuqur kirib ketadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Klassik tavsifda qilich zarb qilingan tanaga chuqur botishi bilan ifodalangan.

issues: Qilich ma’nosi shunchaki «o‘tkir» emas, zarb qilingan tanaga chuqur botishi bilan izohlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|1- شَيْءٌ فَرُودٌ :مُتَفَرِّدٌ، فَرَدٌ، مُتَمَيِّزٌ.|2- نَاقَةٌ فَرُودٌ : تَنْفَرِدُ فِي الْمَرْعَى.
entries.uzbek: yakka va o‘ziga xos; yolg‘iz o‘tlaydigan tuya

meanings.uzbekMeaning: narsa haqida: boshqalardan ajralib turadigan, yakka va o‘ziga xos
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu asar uslubi bilan boshqalardan ajralib turadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urg‘ochi tuya haqida: podadan ajralib, yolg‘iz o‘tlaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Tuya podadan ajralib, yolg‘iz o‘tladi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلْمُبالَغَةِ).|1- طَحُونُ الْحَيِّ : طَحَّانُ.|2- قَائِدُ الطَّحُونِ : الكَتِيبَةُ العَظِيمَةُ الَّتِي تَطْحَنُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ.|3- حَرْبٌ طَحُونٌ : طَاحِنَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: tegirmonchi; oldidagi hamma narsani yakson qiladigan ulkan qo‘shin; qirg‘inbarot urush

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mahalla yoki qavm tegirmonchisi, don yanchuvchi
meanings.uzbekExample: Tegirmonchi qishloq aholisining donini yanchardi.

meanings.arabicGloss: الكَتِيبَةُ العَظِيمَةُ الَّتِي تَطْحَنُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: oldidagi hamma narsani yanchib ketgandek yakson qiladigan ulkan qo‘shin yoki harbiy bo‘linma
meanings.uzbekExample: Sarkarda ulkan va vayronkor qo‘shinga boshchilik qildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urush haqida: nihoyatda shiddatli, qirg‘inbarot va halokatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Qirg‘inbarot urush butun hududni vayron qildi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no shunchaki «maydalovchi» emas, قavm tegirmonchisi
Ikkinchi ma’no oldidagi narsani yanchib ketgandek yakson qiladigan ulkan qo‘shin yoki bo‘linmaga tegishli

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول لِلمبالغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ خَدُومٌ : كَثِيرُ الخِدْمَةِ .

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boshqalarga ko‘p xizmat va yordam ko‘rsatadigan, hojatbaror
meanings.uzbekExample: U odamlarga yordam berishga doim tayyor hojatbaror inson edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول للمُبالَغَةِ).|-رَجُلٌ صَلُوحٌ : كَثِيرُ الصَّلاَحِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: solihligi va yaxshiligi ko‘p bo‘lgan, nihoyatda yaxshi
meanings.uzbekExample: U el orasida juda solih va yaxshi inson sifatida tanilgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول للمُبالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ قَلُوبٌ : مُتَقَلِّبٌ، أَيْ كَثِيرُ التَّقَلُّبِ.|2-  اِسْمٌ مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ الذِّئْبِ.
entries.uzbek: fikri yoki holati tez-tez o‘zgaradigan; bo‘rining nomlaridan biri

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odam haqida: fikri, kayfiyati yoki holatini tez-tez o‘zgartiradigan, beqaror
meanings.uzbekExample: U qarorini tez-tez o‘zgartirib turardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bo‘rining arab tilidagi nomlaridan biri
meanings.uzbekExample: Qalub klassik arab tilida bo‘rining nomlaridan biri sifatida uchraydi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|-رَجُلٌ شَمُومٌ : كَثِيرُ الشَّمِّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘p hidlaydigan yoki tez-tez iskaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U narsalarni ko‘p hidlab tekshirardi.

issues: Manba ko‘p hidlashni bildiradi; «hid bilishda mohir» degan qo‘shimcha qobiliyat kiritilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|-رَجُلٌ عَذُولٌ : كَثِيرُ اللَّوْمِ وَالْعِتَابِ وَالْعَذَلِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boshqalarni ko‘p malomat, ta’na va tanbeh qiladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U boshqalarning xatosini ko‘p yuziga solib, tanbeh berardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|-صَوْتٌ فَجُوعٌ : فَاجِعٌ، يَفْجَعُ النَّاسَ بِالدَّوَاهِي.
entries.uzbek: musibat xabari bilan larzaga soladigan ovoz

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odamlarni kulfat va musibat xabari bilan qayg‘uga soladigan, yurakni larzaga keltiradigan ovoz
meanings.uzbekExample: Musibat xabarini yetkazgan ovoz odamlarni qayg‘uga soldi.

issues: Sifat umumiy «fojiali» emas, musibat xabari bilan odamlarni qayg‘uga soladigan ovozni ifodalaydi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|-مُطْرِبٌ نَغُومٌ : حَسَنُ النَّغْمَةِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xonanda yoki sozanda haqida: ohangi chiroyli, yoqimli kuy chiqaradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ohangi chiroyli xonanda tinglovchilarni maftun etdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|-هَرُورُ عُنْقُودِ الْعِنَبِ : مَا تَنَاثَرَ مِنْهُ فِي أَصْلِ الْكَرْمِ.
entries.uzbek: uzum shingilidan tok tubiga to‘kilgan donalar

meanings.arabicGloss: مَا تَنَاثَرَ مِنْهُ فِي أَصْلِ الْكَرْمِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: uzum shingilidan sochilib, tokning tubiga to‘kilgan uzum donalari
meanings.uzbekExample: Tok tubiga to‘kilgan uzum donalari terib olindi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|-وَجَدَهُ هَيُوفاً : عَطْشَانَ، هَيْفَانَ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qattiq chanqagan, tashnalikdan qiynalayotgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Yo‘lovchi uzoq yo‘ldan keyin qattiq chanqagan edi.

issues: عَطْشَانَ — chanqagan; tibbiy «suvsizlangan» tashxisi alohida ma’no sifatida kiritilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).| مَا يُلْطَخُ بِهِ الشَّيْءُ وَيُغَيِّرُ لَوْنَهُ.

meanings.arabicGloss: مَا يُلْطَخُ بِهِ الشَّيْءُ وَيُغَيِّرُ لَوْنَهُ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror narsaga surtib, uning rangini o‘zgartirish uchun ishlatiladigan modda yoki bo‘yoq
meanings.uzbekExample: Usta buyum yuziga rang beruvchi modda surtdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|1- شَابٌّ وَسُوطُ القَامَةِ : مُتَوَسِّطُهَا.|2- اِسْتَقَرَّ فِي الوَسُوطِ : بَيْتٌ مِنْ بُيُوتِ الشَّعَرِ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ الْمِظَلَّةِ وَأَصْغَرُ مِنَ الخِبَاءِ.
entries.uzbek: o‘rtacha bo‘yli; soyabondan katta, xaymadan kichik jun chodir

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yigit haqida: o‘rtacha bo‘yli
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘rtacha bo‘yli yigit edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: بَيْتٌ مِنْ بُيُوتِ الشَّعَرِ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ الْمِظَلَّةِ وَأَصْغَرُ مِنَ الخِبَاءِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: jun yoki qil gazlamadan tikiladigan, soyabonsimon kichik chodirdan katta, xaymadan kichik chodir turi
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular soyabondan katta, xaymadan kichik jun chodirga joylashdilar.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no «o‘rtada joylashgan» degani emas; jun yoki qil gazlamadan tikilgan, ikki turdagi chodir oralig‘idagi hajmga ega chodir nomi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|1- طَريقٌ دَلوعٌ : واسِعٌ، عَريضٌ.|2- ناقَةٌ دَلوعٌ : مُتَقَدِّمَةُ الإِبِلِ في السَّيْرِ.
entries.uzbek: keng va enli yo‘l; karvon oldida yuradigan tuya

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yo‘l haqida: keng va enli
meanings.uzbekExample: Keng va enli yo‘l karvon yurishiga qulay edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urg‘ochi tuya haqida: safarda boshqa tuyalar oldida yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Tuya yo‘lda karvonning oldida yurdi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no tuyaning oldinda yurishi emas, safarda boshqa tuyalar oldiga chiqib yuradigan tuyaning sifati

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|1- عِرْقٌ نَعُورٌ : يَفُورُ مِنْهُ الدَّمُ- جُرْحٌ نَعُورٌ.|2- رِيحٌ نَعُورٌ : رِيحٌ تُفَاجِئُكَ بِحَرٍّ وَأَنْتَ فِي بَرْدٍ، أَوْ بِبَرْدٍ وَأَنْتَ فِي حَرٍّ.|3- هِمَّةٌ نَعُورٌ : بَعِيدَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: qoni otilib chiqadigan; issiq-sovug‘i kutilmaganda uradigan shamol; yuksak va olis maqsad

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tomir yoki yara haqida: qoni otilib, kuch bilan chiqadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Jarohatdan qon otilib chiqdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: رِيحٌ تُفَاجِئُكَ بِحَرٍّ وَأَنْتَ فِي بَرْدٍ، أَوْ بِبَرْدٍ وَأَنْتَ فِي حَرٍّ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: shamol haqida: sovuq paytda kutilmaganda issiq, issiq paytda esa kutilmaganda sovuq uradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Shamol sovuq havoda birdan issiq esib, odamni hayron qoldirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: intilish haqida: yuksak va uzoqni ko‘zlagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning intilishi yuksak, maqsadi esa uzoqni ko‘zlagan edi.

issues: Birinchi ma’noda yara yoki tomirdan qonning otilib chiqishi aniqlandi
Uchinchi ma’no uzoqdagi oddiy maqsad emas, uzoqni ko‘zlagan yuksak intilish

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|1- وَقُودُ النَّارِ : مَا تُوقَدُ بِهِ.|2- وَقُودُ السَّيَّارَاتِ : النَّفْطُ، البِتْرُولُ، إِذْ يَتَوَلَّدُ مِنِ احْتِرَاقِهَا طَاقَةٌ حَرَارِيَّةٌ، وَيُطْلَقُ عَلَى كُلِّ مَادَّةٍ مِنْ هَذَا النَّوْعِ كَالغَازِ مَثَلاً- مَخْزَنُ الوَقُودِ.|3- الوَقُودُ النَّوَوِيُّ : الْمَادَّةُ القَابِلَةُ لِلانْشِطَارِ، تُسْتَعْمَلُ فِي الْمُفَاعِلِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: olovni yoqish va yondirish uchun ishlatiladigan modda, yoqilg‘i
meanings.uzbekExample: Olov yoqish uchun quruq o‘tin yoqilg‘i bo‘ldi.

meanings.arabicGloss: النَّفْطُ، البِتْرُولُ، إِذْ يَتَوَلَّدُ مِنِ احْتِرَاقِهَا طَاقَةٌ حَرَارِيَّةٌ، وَيُطْلَقُ عَلَى كُلِّ مَادَّةٍ مِنْ هَذَا النَّوْعِ كَالغَازِ مَثَلاً- مَخْزَنُ الوَقُودِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: avtomobil va boshqa dvigatellarda yonib energiya hosil qiladigan neft mahsuloti, benzin, gaz kabi yoqilg‘i
meanings.uzbekExample: Avtomobilga mos turdagi yoqilg‘i quyildi.

meanings.arabicGloss: الْمَادَّةُ القَابِلَةُ لِلانْشِطَارِ، تُسْتَعْمَلُ فِي الْمُفَاعِلِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: yadro reaktorida ishlatiladigan, bo‘linish xususiyatiga ega modda; yadro yoqilg‘isi
meanings.uzbekExample: Yadro yoqilg‘isi reaktorda energiya hosil qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

issues: Umumiy, transport va yadro yoqilg‘isi terminlari alohida saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|1- وَلَدٌ دَفُوعٌ : كَثِيرُ الدَّفْعِ.|2- نَاقَةٌ دَفُوعٌ : تَدْفَعُ بِرِجْلِهَا عِنْدَ الحَلْبِ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘p itaradigan bola; sog‘ishda tepib yuboradigan tuya

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: boshqalarni yoki narsalarni ko‘p itaradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola o‘yin paytida boshqalarni ko‘p itarardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urg‘ochi tuya haqida: sog‘ish vaqtida oyog‘i bilan tepib yuboradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Tuya sog‘ish paytida oyog‘i bilan tepib yubordi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعُول).|1- كُلُّ مَا هُوَ فَتِيتٌ، يَسْقُطُ فَيَتَقَطَّعُ وَيَتَفَتَّتُ.|2- طَعَامُهُ كَانَ فَتُوتاً : خُبْزاً مَفْتُوتاً، وَهُوَ مَا يُعَالَجُ بِالتَّوَابِلِ وَالزَّيْتِ.
entries.uzbek: uvalanib maydalanadigan narsa; ziravor va yog‘li uvalangan non taomi

meanings.arabicGloss: كُلُّ مَا هُوَ فَتِيتٌ، يَسْقُطُ فَيَتَقَطَّعُ وَيَتَفَتَّتُ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: tushganda bo‘laklarga bo‘linib, uvalanib ketadigan har qanday narsa
meanings.uzbekExample: Quruq modda yerga tushib, mayda uvoqlarga bo‘lindi.

meanings.arabicGloss: خُبْزاً مَفْتُوتاً، وَهُوَ مَا يُعَالَجُ بِالتَّوَابِلِ وَالزَّيْتِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: nonni uvalab, ziravor va yog‘ bilan tayyorlanadigan taom
meanings.uzbekExample: Uvalangan non ziravor va yog‘ bilan aralashtirib tayyorlandi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِلٌ).|-كَانَ رَجُلاً تَرِفاً : مُتَنَعِّماً فِي النَّعيمِ .

meanings.uzbekMeaning: nozu ne’mat ichida, hashamat va farovonlikda yashaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U nozu ne’mat va farovonlikda yashardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِلٍ).|-وَلَدٌ حَلِقٌ : لاَ شَعْرَ فِيهِ نَابِتٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: boshida soch o‘sib chiqmagan, sochsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat sochi chiqmagan bolaga nisbatan ishlatilgan.

issues: Manbada faqat sochi o‘sib chiqmagan bola bor; mavjud «kalta sochli» ikkinchi ma’nosi chiqarildi
